ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the image, on the left side a generic substituent R can be seen, connected to a segment of carbon chain; this carbon chain continues to connect to a boron atom B marked with a negative charge. The boron atom is also connected to two R′ substituents, and is connected to the O-OH peroxy/hydroperoxy fragment on the right side. There are curved arrows in the image, but the problem requires ignoring these arrows. Reasoning: According to the visible σ-bond skeleton, starting from the generic substituent on the left side, it is written as *CC[B-]; the two R′ substituents on boron are represented with two generic branches as [B-](*)(*); boron is further connected to the O-OH fragment, written as OO. Therefore the complete SMILES is *CC[B-](*)(*)OO.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: Ignore all curved arrows as instructed. Convert the visible sigma-bond framework into a linear SMILES path starting from the left generic substituent: `*CC[B-]`. Add the two generic R′ groups as branches on boron, giving `[B-](*)(*)`, then append the peroxide/hydroperoxide chain attached to boron as `OO`. The resulting SMILES is `*CC[B-](*)(*)OO`.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中可见左侧为一个通用取代基 R，连接到一段碳链；该碳链继续连接到带负电荷标记的硼原子 B。硼原子还连接两个 R′ 取代基，并连接到右侧的 O-OH 过氧/氢过氧基片段。图中有弯曲箭头，但题目要求忽略这些箭头。
推理：按可见 σ 键骨架从左侧通用取代基开始写作 *CC[B-]；硼上的两个 R′ 取代基用两个通用支链表示为 [B-](*)(*)；硼再连接 O-OH 片段，写作 OO。因此完整 SMILES 为 *CC[B-](*)(*)OO。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct structure-to-SMILES transcription from the displayed transition-state skeleton; no alternative reaction-mechanism interpretation is needed because the prompt says to ignore arrows.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the atoms and connectivity in the image: a left R group attached to a carbon bearing H, followed by a carbon bonded to negatively charged boron; boron also has two R′ substituents and is bonded to an O–O–H group. Curved arrows are present but excluded.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction to produce a SMILES expression for the transition-state structure and specifically to ignore the arrows.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent unspecified R/R′ substituents as wildcard atoms `*`; write boron with formal negative charge as `[B-]`; hydrogens on ordinary carbon and terminal hydroxyl oxygen can be implicit; branches from boron are written in parentheses.
